question: In a certain code language, 'CONSUME' is written as 'CEMNOSU' and 'COMPEL' is written as 'CELMOP'. How will 'ENGLISH' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

 
• CONSUME

 
 
• Alphabetical order of letters: C 
 
• Therefore, code = CEMNOSU
 
 
 
• COMPEL
 
 
• Alphabetical order of letters: C 
 
 
• ENGLISH
 
 
• Alphabetical order of letters: E 
 

Hence, **"option 1"** is the correct answer.
